sites.name: Yungang Grottoes
sites.what: Buddhist rock-cut caves and sculpture at Datong, including the Five Caves associated with Tan Yao.

ancient-sites-and-mysteries.summary: 1 site(s) recorded. Recent entries use UNESCO heritage descriptions or, where stated, a tentative-list index; visitor access still needs checking.

laws.rule: Visitors must follow the law and public manners, keep to the written contract or agreement, follow tourism order, safety and health rules, look after tourism resources, facilities and the environment, and respect local customs and religion (article 48).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
laws.heading: 山西省旅游条例 (Shanxi Province Tourism Regulation)

laws.rule: In a scenic area it is banned to quarry or dig, damage the water system, fell or damage old trees or dig up plants, carve or scribble on features or facilities, and drop litter (article 23).
laws.penalty_signal: Digging up flowers, grass or seedlings: warning and, in serious cases, CNY 50 to 1,000 (about A$10.67 to A$213) (article 46). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 山西省风景名胜区条例 (Shanxi Province Scenic Areas Regulation)

laws.rule: Pingyao Ancient City: setting off fireworks and sky lanterns is banned inside the old city (article 17), as are unsafe electrics and storing flammables. Putting up signs, advertising or fittings, and running any business, needs approval (article 15). Businesses may not use loud equipment, and guides may not use open-air loudspeakers (article 21).
laws.penalty_signal: Putting up signs or similar without approval: warning, then CNY 200 (about A$42.66) for an individual (article 47). Loud equipment: CNY 1,000 to 5,000 (about A$213 to A$1,067) for the business and CNY 50 to 200 (about A$10.67 to A$42.66) for a guide (article 48). Penalty for the fire-risk acts in article 17 not read. (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 山西省平遥古城保护条例 (Shanxi Province Pingyao Ancient City Protection Regulation)

laws.rule: Yungang Grottoes: inside the protected area it is banned to rub or take rubbings of the carvings, touch, carve, scribble on or climb the relics and fittings, bring pets into the scenic area, smoke or burn incense outside set places, and use flash photography in key caves (article 16). In the buffer zone it is banned to release sky lanterns or fly drones, and to set off fireworks or burn stubble and rubbish (article 15). Large cultural or sports events that could endanger the relics need the city government's approval (article 34).
laws.penalty_signal: Carving, scribbling or damaging relics: warning and CNY 100 to 200 (about A$21.33 to A$42.66) (article 39). Smoking in the scenic area or flash photography in key caves: warning and CNY 50 to 200 (about A$10.67 to A$42.66) (article 40). Damaging a protection marker: CNY 200 (about A$42.66) (article 38). Penalty for pets, drones and sky lanterns not read. (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
